data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Phoebe was a goddess of fertility and the earth, associated with the bright moon. In Christianity, Phoebe of Cenchreae was a deaconess and a helper of Paul and other apostles. The name Phoebe means "shining brightly" and is a reminder of God's divine light in our lives. The name Phoelina carries the meaning “Shining brightly” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English. Parents who choose Phoelina usually hope their child will grow to embody shining brightly and live with faith, good character and purpose.
